game_title: Iteration Tracer – Hollow Log Trail Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail, a trail through hollow logs: the wood elf archer must handle cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Iteration Tracer: Predict how many times a loop body runs before the clock stops.
theme: Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail: a trail through hollow logs
core_gameplay_loop: In Hollow Log Trail, repeat each round: Predict how many times a loop body runs before the clock stops. Each round, cursed treants strike the mushroom ring, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the trace_score value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the mushroom ring from cursed treants in Hollow Log Trail: keep the trace_score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 31-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: trace_score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 31-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Iteration Tracer
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
